name: Mace Windu
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Amethyst lightsaber planted in cracked Jedi Temple stone
Shatterpoint crystal lattice mounted on a Jedi Council chair fragment
187th Legion clone pauldron with a purple blade motif on a Coruscant plinth

factionTrait.name: Duelist Champion
factionTrait.text: A duelist moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy champion.

uniqueTraits.name: Shatterpoint Focus
uniqueTraits.text: Mace Windu gains a +2 bonus for boons instead of a +1 bonus.

ultimate.name: This Party's Over
ultimate.text: All enemies within range gain {dodge_blight} and {move_blight}.

plotSkills.name: Clone Assault
plotSkills.text: Move each 187th Legion that is within range up to 2 hexes.

plotSkills.name: I Don't Think So
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Inflict {protection_blight}. Move Mace Windu up to 1 hex towards the target.

clashSkills.name: Finishing Strike
alternateNames: He's Too Dangerous to Be Left Alive
clashSkills.text: If this skill wounds its target, they gain wounds until they are knocked out.

clashSkills.name: Exploit the Weakness
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: If the target has {move_blight}, {accuracy_die_blight}, or {damage_die_blight} it gains 1 wound.

traits.name: You Will Pay for That
traits.text: After an enemy model uses a skill to knock out one or more 187th Legion, the enemy model gains {dodge_blight}.

plotSkills.name: Keepers of the Peace
plotSkills.text: If Mace Windu is within range, he gains {accuracy_die_boon} or {move_boon}.

plotSkills.name: Pin Them Down
plotSkills.text: This skill has +1 {accuracy_die} for each 187th Legion adjacent to the target. Hit Effect: Inflict {damage_die_blight}.

clashSkills.name: Take Them Down
clashSkills.text: This skill has +1 {accuracy_die} for each 187th Legion adjacent to the target.
